headline: Sharks’ Alex Wennberg activated off IR, will return to lineup
take:
Daily Faceoff reports the Sharks have activated Alex Wennberg off injured reserve, back in the lineup after missing time since October with an upper-body injury.

San Jose needs bodies who can tilt the ice, because right now it tilts the wrong way. The Sharks are 7-11-1 with 42% of the expected goals (the quality of chances each side creates), and they've scored 9.5 fewer goals than those chances usually produce. The one thing holding up is the goaltending, 9.1 goals better than expected. That's a team being outplayed and bailed out at the same time, and goaltending like that rarely lasts a full season. A veteran center doesn't fix a 42% team, but he does push someone out of a role he shouldn't be playing, and that's where we'd look first when Wennberg is back.
